mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 60-day forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 255 on a monthly basis, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt central bank hawkishness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market with unemployment below 3.5% and employment above 150,000 thousand persons generates strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 150000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During housing expansion cycles characterized by rising housing starts (HOUST > 1200), the construction sector's growth spillover to consumer spending and corporate investment drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of housing expansion cycles (HOUST > 1200), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The level of housing starts (HOUST) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns, as higher housing activity signals robust consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between HOUST and 60-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation is negative in more than 60% of 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, when the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, the increased cost of capital reduces corporate investment and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 108) signals a monetary policy-induced economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and INDPRO < 108.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
